sections.title: Overview
sections.content: The Hunt is a story encounter in Prologue & Weeping Creek Valley, found at Main road pursuit, returns later. Beating it yields Hunter's Chain Sickle (Great Waterfall, same region).

sections.title: Where to Find the The Hunt
sections.content:
Location: Main road pursuit, returns later.

Appears in: Prologue & Weeping Creek Valley.

Not confirmed post-launch. Phantom Blade Zero does not run an elemental damage system, so there is no weakness table to fill in - nothing here is estimated from how a boss looks, which is exactly how wrong weakness tables get written.

What the game does have is a colour language on enemy attacks, and it is the single most useful thing to learn: a red flash marks an unblockable attack that must be dodged, a blue flash marks a parryable one that should be deflected, and a purple flash means the boss has just parried you and a counter is coming. See the combat system for how Sha-Chi feeds into this.

sections.title: How to Beat the The Hunt
sections.content:
What works

  • Learn his attack rhythm first; the punish window is after the follow-up, not after the first swing.
  • He returns later in the story at a higher level, so the early fight doubles as a rehearsal.

sections.title: Status
sections.content: This page tracks the The Hunt in Phantom Blade Zero, released October 29, 2026. Location, drops and tactics are filled from the shipped game and from published fight guides; anything still marked “not confirmed post-launch” has not been confirmed by any source we could check.
